Coverage audit

SOC Console Coverage

Every UI pattern in the deployed SOC console prototype, matched against what @vcyberizadmin/ui actually exports. Read it as a build list: the gaps at the bottom are the work.

Looking for one control? Rows are named the way you would say them out loud — Button, Dropdown, Slider — with the prototype's own selector underneath. Every exported component is also listed A–Z at the end. For the visual A/B, start with Side by side.

Source · d1emosftugdkpc.cloudfront.net Library · packages/ui @ 83ce43a After PR #5 (CX-DCK + CX-CBR)

Side by side

5 components · live browser, 1440px, dark

What we built, against the same component on d1emosftugdkpc.cloudfront.net. Both captured from a real browser at the same width; every figure is measured from the rendered DOM, not read off the source.

Matched, except type and one motion token. Ground, surfaces, corner radii and every dimension now agree with the site — the library was rethemed to the console's surface set and a rounder radius scale, and the two defects this comparison originally surfaced are fixed. Typography deliberately holds at Space Grotesk and Inter, because that is the brand ramp; the console uses Plus Jakarta Sans.

Both defects this comparison found are fixed

Resolved
WasNow
Rail on 400px scroll−220px, off screenunmoved, as the site=
Rail panel height848px676px, as the site=
Scope ink glownone0 0 16px accent=
--fg-muted on --surface4.46:1 — below AA4.94:1=

The rail scrolled away because AppShell's dock mode let the document scroll; it is now viewport-height at xl with the content column owning the overflow, which is what the console does. The contrast repair was caused BY the retheme: lifting --surface to the console's lighter grey pushed the muted ink below AA, so it was lifted to #9294a6. All 48 ink-on-surface pairs in both themes were re-measured and clear 4.5:1.

What to build

11 open items, hardest first

Ordered by how much an app has to invent without them.

Investigation timeline Missing

Timestamps down a rail, each step expanding in place. Nothing in the library is close, and it is the spine of the case detail screen.

Coverage heatmap Missing

MITRE tactic grid. The theme already ships the sequential ramp it needs (--seq-1…8); no component consumes it yet.

Agent conversation surface Partial

CommandPalette runs commands. The Ask overlay holds a conversation — prompt, streamed reply, send. Decide whether that is a second component or a mode of the first.

Slider Missing

The prototype styles a native input[type=range] for the autonomy threshold. Small to build, but there is nothing to reach for today, and settings is where thresholds live.

Interactive chart readout Partial

Sparkline is server-safe by contract, so it cannot carry a hover marker. Either an opt-in client variant, or write the decision down so the next person does not rediscover it.

Arc gauge Partial

The severity gauge is a 180° arc; Donut is a full circle. Likely a prop on Donut rather than a new component.

Export the count badge Partial

Both DockRail and ConsoleBar define one privately. Two copies is a coincidence; a third would be a pattern nobody owns.

Export the colour tile Partial

Same shape of problem — ConsoleBar has one for notification sources and scope monograms.

Standalone list row Partial

The prototype's .row appears outside tables constantly. Ours only exists as a DataTable row.

Card "needs action" variant Partial

An inset ring marking a card that is waiting on a human. One prop on Card.

Sankey — decide, don't drift By design

Not a gap today. FunnelFlow deliberately renders bars instead. Worth a deliberate revisit rather than quietly hand-rolling one in the app.

Method. The prototype was read from source, not from screenshots: its CSS component layer gives the primitive vocabulary, its element ids and render functions give the widgets. Claims about what it lacks were counted, not assumed — aria-modal, role="menu", aria-sort, toast and skeleton all return zero occurrences, and its one <table> has no sort semantics. The library side is its four export entry points.

A caveat on the count. 42 is a count of patterns worth naming, not a measurement. The prototype's case-detail cards — evidence, findings, IOCs, ledger, notes, records, report, resolution, tasks — are app compositions built from the primitives above, so they are deliberately not counted as components.
